brief: A listening-first store for R&B, Afro and Trap beats. The selected Two Takes mark uses two offset track corners around an open center.
criteria: Retain the approved C silhouette, keep the small-size gap open and pair the symbol with readable outlined lettering.

concepts.name: Two Takes
concepts.idea: Two offset track corners share one open center.
rationale: Approved direction C with its original square silhouette.
Outlined Bricolage Grotesque lettering needs no font installation.
Small-size cut follows a two-pixel grid at 16px.

recommendation: Selected direction C has been applied to the frontend. Digital masters and web icons accompany the usage guide. Mockups illustrate possible brand uses only.
next_steps: Keep the symbol upright and preserve the open center.
Use the horizontal lockup when the name needs to be read.
Arrange professional trademark clearance before commercial adoption.
